question.prompt: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(AB=7\), \(BC=8\), and \(CA=9\). The incircle is tangent to \(BC\) at \(E\). Find the length of \(BE\).

solutions.explanation: Let the points of tangency lie on \(AB\), \(BC\), and \(CA\), respectively. By equality of tangent lengths, \(BE=(AB+BC-CA)/2=(7+8-9)/2=3\).
solutions.title: Combine equal tangent segments
